Fred Wesley has enjoyed a creative life as a trombonist, composer, arranger, and band leader. His contributions to the sound of James Brown band and Parliament-Funkadellic is unmistakable and integral to their success.
Fred was interviewed via Zoom on November 21, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
